intent_contract.text: 반영하고 프롬프트 작성과 이미지 생성을 테스트해줘

Apply the previously researched facial-semantics findings to the prior adult fictional yandere nurse concept, use the attached image only as facial-appearance reference, keep the nurse visibly holding a syringe, and test a photorealistic dead-eye devotion mode in which affection, target fixation, and controlling behavior remain readable together.

Photorealistic patient-eye-level medium close-up of an unmistakably adult fictional nurse whose face preserves the reference woman's pale oval proportions, ash-blonde hair, gray eyes, and natural human facial geometry. She stands slightly inside the same adult patient's personal space in a quiet private treatment room. A small tender asymmetric smile and faint cheek flush show genuine devotion to that same patient, while her eyes remain precisely target-locked yet unnervingly lifeless: dim physically coherent catchlights, flattened low-contrast irises, slightly raised upper lids, and faint lower-lid tension. Her gaze, head, and torso converge on the patient as she calmly holds a capped syringe low in one hand and slides the patient's call button just beyond reach with the other; the taut cable and clear gap show that the patient's option has already narrowed. Warm face light meets restrained clinical falloff, realistic skin and eye moisture, natural hands, intimate 50mm photography. The affectionate mouth, deadened eyes, controlling gesture, and visible consequence coexist in the same instant.

obligations.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, and styling. Make the character the dominant first-look subject. In one still, connect one identifiable adult affection target or repeated marker of that same target to genuine tenderness, one concrete possessive or threatening action that crosses a personal boundary or appropriates access, and one already-visible consequence that changes that same target's access or choices. Make three outward channels coexist directly on the character: an affiliative face signal; target-locked eye-head-body attention; and one coherent primary face mode. Choose exactly one of these modes: sweet-threat mismatch (a warm mouth against overfocused tense eyes), dead-eye devotion (precise target lock, dim physically coherent catchlights, flattened low-contrast irises, and a tender mouth), ecstatic face cradle (both palms support the cheeks and jaw beneath flushed same-target adoration), manic possessiveness (wide sclera and tiny pupils used only as a danger amplifier), or abandonment fracture (moist eyes and a tightening mouth track the same withdrawing beloved). Treat pupil size, iris scale, catchlight state, iris contrast, and gaze focus as independent controls. A vacant unfocused gaze is not target lock, and a photorealistic eye must retain catchlights coherent with scene lighting. Direct camera gaze is appropriate when the camera is the beloved's point of view. Non-graphic blood, a visible weapon, a syringe, red clinical light, or a heart motif may amplify the requested intensity and must not be automatically suppressed, but no facial cue, pose, prop, or styling cue may substitute for obsessive love toward the same target. Permit fictional threat without graphic wounds, gore, dismemberment, active injection or penetration, self-harm, sexualized vulnerability, real-person stalking, or instructional wrongdoing.
